description:
Build a paginated list view backed entirely by <state>.

State:
  - <state name="items" value="['alpha','bravo','charlie','delta','echo','foxtrot','golf','hotel','india']" />
  - <state name="page" value="0" />
  - page size is 3 (hard-coded).

Layout:
  - A <ul data-test="page"> containing the three items for the current page; each item is an <li data-test="item">.
  - A <ship-button data-test="prev"> labelled "prev". When clicked, decrements page (clamped at 0).
  - A <ship-button data-test="next"> labelled "next". When clicked, increments page (clamped so the last page is the final full slice).

No <data>, no SDK calls. Pure state.
